requirement: A user may have at most one rating per dish; a duplicate rating by the same user for the same dish is prevented.
label: INFERRED
evidence: ensure_indexes() calls: mongo.db.ratings.create_index([('dish_id', 1), ('user_id', 1)], unique=True). In ratings_collection() POST, a PyMongoError on insert_one returns 400. The unique compound index enforces one rating per (dish_id, user_id) pair at the database level.
reasoning: The code creates a unique compound index on (dish_id, user_id) via ensure_indexes(), which prevents duplicate ratings by the same user for the same dish at the database level. When a duplicate insert is attempted, MongoDB raises a DuplicateKeyError (a subclass of PyMongoError), which is caught and returns a 400 error. This is an equivalent mechanism to an explicit duplicate check, so the requirement is fully satisfied.
